name: Zed Pro

reset.rule: Resets on your monthly billing date.
stipulations: Hosted models cost the provider's list price plus 10%.
Edit predictions are unlimited and don't spend credit.
Claude Fable 5.2 fast mode doubles its rates.
Your own keys and external agents don't spend credit.
The docs don't say whether unused credit carries over.

overage: Past $5, usage bills at list price plus 10%, charged at month end or every $10, whichever comes first. Overage is on by default, up to a $10 spend limit. Set the limit to $0 to turn it off. At the limit, hosted models stop until the next cycle.

how: $5 of hosted-model tokens a month, at list price plus 10%.
ext: Hosted Claude, GPT and Gemini models. Hosted xAI models were removed on 15 May 2026.
Your own API keys, Ollama and GitHub Copilot work on any plan and don't use Zed credit.
External agents (Claude Agent, Codex, Gemini CLI, any ACP agent) run in Zed at no charge and bill through your own account with that provider.
quirks: The 14-day trial gives $5 of GPT-6 Luna only, and ends early if the $5 runs out.
Zed Business ($30 a seat) has no bundled credit.
